error.bad_certificate: A certificate cannot be read. Paste it again in full, from -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- to -----END CERTIFICATE-----.
error.bad_key: The private key cannot be read. Paste it again in full.
error.duplicate: This certificate has been added already.
error.encrypted_key: The private key is protected by a passphrase. Remove it first, for example with openssl pkey -in key.pem -out plain.pem, then paste the key again.
error.key_mismatch: The private key does not belong to this certificate. Check that both come from the same order or CSR.
error.no_certificate: No certificate found. Paste the certificate in PEM format, starting with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
error.no_key: No private key found. Paste the private key in PEM format.
error.not_newer: This certificate expires before the one in use. Upload a newer certificate.
error.other_domains: This certificate is not for {domain}. Upload one that covers {domain}, or add it as a new certificate.
error.several_keys: More than one private key was pasted. Keep only the key of this certificate.
error.unsupported_key: This type of private key is not supported. Use an RSA, ECDSA or Ed25519 key.

error.internal: The server hit an error. Try again, and check the server log if it keeps happening.
error.invalid_request: The request is not valid. Check what you entered and try again.
error.login_failed: The username or password is wrong. After {attempts, plural, one {# failed attempt} other {# failed attempts}} in a row, sign-in is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
error.method_not_allowed: This action is not supported here.
error.network: JEC cannot be reached. Check that the server is running, then try again.
error.not_found: This item does not exist. It may have been deleted.
error.setup_done: JEC is already set up. Sign in instead.
error.setup_token_invalid: The setup token is wrong. Copy it again from the server log.
error.too_large: The request is too large. Send a smaller file.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
